marrakech.name: Marrakech
marrakech.blurb: The red city: souks, courtyards, gardens and Jemaa el-Fnaa, with the Atlas on the horizon.

fez.name: Fez
fez.blurb: Medina lanes, tanneries, madrasas and zellige: Morocco's medieval capital in pictures.

sahara.name: The Sahara
sahara.blurb: Dunes, camel caravans and desert light across Morocco's Sahara.

atlas.name: Atlas Mountains & Southern Morocco
atlas.blurb: Kasbahs, palm oases, gorges and mountain valleys on the roads south.

essaouira.name: Essaouira & the Atlantic Coast
essaouira.blurb: Ramparts, blue fishing boats and ocean light on Morocco's Atlantic edge.

casablanca.name: Casablanca
casablanca.blurb: The Hassan II Mosque and the Atlantic gateway to Morocco.

chefchaouen.name: Chefchaouen
chefchaouen.blurb: The blue-washed lanes and hillside views of the Rif Mountains.

rabat.name: Rabat
rabat.blurb: The capital's Hassan Tower, mausoleum and the Kasbah of the Udayas.

meknes.name: Meknes & Volubilis
meknes.blurb: Imperial gates, granaries and the Roman ruins of Volubilis.

tangier.name: Tangier & the North
tangier.blurb: Cap Spartel, the Caves of Hercules and Tangier's old fortifications.

agadir.name: Agadir
agadir.blurb: Morocco's southern Atlantic resort city and its sweeping bay.

ifrane.name: Ifrane & the Middle Atlas
ifrane.blurb: Cedar country, Barbary macaques and winter snow in the Middle Atlas.
